rivals.B: Opposite lateral contrasts are consumed but do not produce a material command difference under the frozen organism within 400 ms.

controls: Same basal checkpoint, separate but exact prepared states, 40-ms odor-free preparation, fixed physical source and sigma, source-independent forward command, existing motor decoder, signed flow taps and actual ORN/PN consumer observation. The previous negative is retained as exposed context, not relabeled or promoted.

preflight.guard_basis: Seven already exposed Stage3 prepared poses: maximum common pair discrepancy 4.0118686151e-11 and prior-common discrepancy 2.0018653402e-11. The 1e-10 bounds are input/pose identity tolerances, not a change to neural, motor or numerical-effect criteria.

observation.scope: Exact committed sensor/trace lag and selected ORN argument buffers, plus signed PN/DN kernel net and target at each accepted millisecond; not every hidden kernel read.

sequential_decision: Check all frozen sources, old native evidence and disk reserve before any launch.
Run strict plus once, preserve and stop if incomplete or invalid.
Only then run strict minus once.
Recompute each raw arm, exact prepared reference pair, parity against old native pair, and campaign budget without trusting runner PASS flags.
stop: At most one prospective plus and one prospective minus strict run. Stop if plus is incomplete/invalid or any run exceeds its cap. No retuning after new results. Preserve failed attempts and do not relabel Campaign26.
qualification: A successful composite result confirms only mirrored source-to-command numerical parity locally; Stage4 navigation and Stage5 perturbation remain open.

recovery_rivals.A: A prospective full strict pair finishes within budget and matches the exposed native effect within the unchanged thresholds.
recovery_rivals.B: References finish but violate numerical parity or the signed source-to-command effect.
recovery_rivals.C: A new reference times out or source, preparation, flow, consumer, memory or run-inventory integrity fails; no numerical inference.
